item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 07/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a trough of low pressure, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. With the trough of low pressure weakening, showers will lessen gradually and the weather will improve slightly over the region early next week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Yun-yeung will move towards the vicinity of Honshu of Japan tomorrow.
